"Please make a game with the Stardew Valley vibe set in a fantasy world. For animal husbandry, use fantasy or mythical creatures; for farming, allow catching magical fish with magical plants and Marxies; and make the town a medieval fantasy village. Create a format similar to an open world, and in addition, add a mine, NPCs, NPC friendship levels, special friendship animations, and a first ending. Furthermore, include all the Stardew Valley systems. Do not make it exactly the same. It is a pixel art game. It features indie game sound. Create pixel art images for every item and improve the overall graphical quality. Also, remove emoticons and use pixel art instead. (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
